tasks.title: Lecture #7
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in a psychology class.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the talk?

options.A: The benefits of long-term financial planning
options.C: How to recover lost investments in business

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：这段讲话的主题是什么？ 定位原文：Today, we're exploring the sunk cost fallacy, a cognitive bias that often leads to irrational decision-making. 选项分析： A. The benefits of long-term financial planning（长期财务规划的好处）。由于长期财务规划只是结尾提到的下一节内容，并非本节主题，所以A选项错误。 B. A psychological bias in decision-making（决策中的心理偏差）。因为教授开篇就明确指出本节探讨的是沉没成本谬误，这是一种导致非理性决策的认知偏差，因此B选项正确。 C. How to recover lost investments in business（如何在商业中收回损失的投资）。基于讲话没有讨论如何收回损失，而是讲解一种心理偏差，所以C选项错误。 D. The history of cognitive research（认知研究的历史）。由于讲话完全没有涉及认知研究的历史，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what is a sunk cost?

options.A: A resource that can be recovered in the future
options.B: A future expense that must be avoided
options.C: An investment that has already been made and cannot be recovered
options.D: A profit that exceeds initial expectations

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：根据演讲者，什么是沉没成本？ 定位原文：In reality, the money is gone—it's a "sunk cost"—and by staying, they are only wasting two more hours of their time. 选项分析： A. A resource that can be recovered in the future（未来可以收回的资源）。因为教授明确说钱已经花出去了，无法收回，所以A选项错误。 B. A future expense that must be avoided（必须避免的未来开支）。由于沉没成本指的是已经发生的投入，而非未来开支，所以B选项错误。 C. An investment that has already been made and cannot be recovered（已经发生且无法收回的投资）。基于教授举例说明电影票的钱已经花出去了，无法要回来，这正是沉没成本的定义，因此C选项正确。 D. A profit that exceeds initial expectations（超出初始预期的利润）。因为沉没成本与利润无关，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention a three-hour movie?

options.A: To illustrate how the sunk cost fallacy affects daily choices
options.B: To argue that people should watch more films
options.C: To explain the importance of finishing what one starts
options.D: To compare the cost of movies with business investments

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：演讲者为什么提到一场三小时的电影？ 定位原文：For instance, imagine you bought a ticket to a three-hour movie. After thirty minutes, you realize the movie is terrible and you aren't enjoying it. However, most people will stay until the end because they already paid for the ticket. 选项分析： A. To illustrate how the sunk cost fallacy affects daily choices（说明沉没成本谬误如何影响日常选择）。由于教授用"For instance"引出这个例子，生动展示了人们因为已经买了票而坚持看完烂片的日常场景，这正是沉没成本谬误的典型表现，所以A选项正确。 B. To argue that people should watch more films（主张人们应该多看电影）。因为教授没有表达这个观点，所以B选项错误。 C. To explain the importance of finishing what one starts（解释善始善终的重要性）。基于教授实际上是在批评这种做法，认为留下来只是在浪费更多时间，所以C选项错误。 D. To compare the cost of movies with business investments（比较电影花费与商业投资）。由于电影例子是为了通俗解释概念，而非与商业投资做对比，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What will the speaker discuss next?

options.A: The psychological effects of wasting time
options.B: Techniques to identify and prevent the fallacy in finance
options.C: Case studies of successful business ventures
options.D: The origin of the term "sunk cost"

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：演讲者接下来将讨论什么？ 定位原文：Next, we will discuss how to recognize and avoid the sunk cost fallacy in long-term financial planning. 选项分析： A. The psychological effects of wasting time（浪费时间的心理影响）。因为教授没有提到要讨论这个话题，所以A选项错误。 B. Techniques to identify and prevent the fallacy in finance（在财务中识别和预防这一谬误的技巧）。由于教授明确说接下来要讨论如何识别和避免沉没成本谬误在长期财务规划中的应用，因此B选项正确。 C. Case studies of successful business ventures（成功商业案例研究）。基于教授没有提及案例研究，所以C选项错误。 D. The origin of the term "sunk cost"（"沉没成本"一词的起源）。因为教授没有说要讨论这个术语的起源，所以D选项错误。
